attchmntText: Reliable Data Services Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Reliable Data Services Limited announced the outcome of its fourth Board Meeting held on 12.11.2026. The Board approved the unaudited standalone financial results for the quarter ended 30th September 2026. The Board also approved the unaudited consolidated financial results for the same period. Independent auditors KARMV And Company conducted limited reviews of both standalone and consolidated results. The auditors reported no material misstatements in the financial statements. The consolidated results include subsidiaries such as Kandarp Digi Smart BPO Limited and joint ventures like Total Outsourcing Solutions. The standalone balance sheet as at 30th September 2026 shows total assets of 6,114.12 lakhs. Shareholders' funds stood at 11,724.40 lakhs. The company filed these results with the National Stock Exchange and Bombay Stock Exchange.

Reliable Data Services Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Announcement regarding new business'.
